title: Enter PIN to get back in
summary: Asks for the account PIN after the other factor passed: the synced recovery token, the link in the recovery e-mail, or a linked Apple or Google account (ADR 0059: the PIN comes last). A wrong PIN counts against the account; 5 in total block it.

factor.description: token: the synced recovery token from recovery-start. emailLink: the token of the link from the recovery e-mail. linked: the proof of recovery-linked (an ID token, or flow_id and handoff).

pin.description: Digits typed, at most pinLength. Never logged.

phase.description: checking: the request runs. wrong: pin_wrong with triesLeft. blocked: pin_blocked. failed: network, rate limit or recovery_invalid.

error.description: String key of a failed state: bipe_error_network, bipe_error_rate_limited, bipe_error_recovery_invalid or bipe_error_generic.

typeDigit.effect: Adds the digit. At pinLength digits, submits.

submit.effect: token: POST /v1/recovery/token with the token and the PIN; on 200 stores the new password (this device only) and the new token (synced), signs in with Client.login and opens chat-list, then encryption-status. emailLink: POST /v1/recovery/email/confirm with the link token and the PIN; on 200 keeps recovery_id and claim_secret on this device and opens recovery-waiting. linked: POST /v1/recovery/link with the provider, the proof and the PIN; on 201 keeps recovery_id and claim_secret on this device and opens recovery-waiting.

forgotPin.effect: emailLink: asks for a new PIN (the signup-pin steps with bipe_recovery_new_pin_title) and sends it as new_pin, which starts a pin_reset recovery. token: explains that the PIN resets only through the recovery e-mail and opens recovery-email. linked: shows bipe_recovery_linked_pin_blocked (a linked account never resets the PIN) and offers recovery-email.

notes: bipe_pin_wrong takes triesLeft; bipe_pin_blocked_body takes pinMaxWrongTries from registries/accounts.json.
recovery_invalid on the token path: the synced token is old or revoked. Delete it from the synced store and go back to recovery-start without the token row.
A synced-token sign-in has no delay. The old devices get the bipe_recovery_alert_token notice (recovery-alert).
With two accounts on the phone (ADR 0086), this is the server PIN of the account that comes back, not the device PIN of the app lock.

Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.recoverWithToken and confirmRecoveryEmail, BipeCredentialStore.save, saveRecoveryToken, deleteRecoveryToken and savePendingRecovery (iOS); BipeDeviceAccount.recoverWithToken and confirmEmailRecovery (Android).
recovery_invalid on the linked path: shows bipe_recovery_linked_invalid and goes back to recovery-start. pin_blocked on the linked path shows bipe_recovery_linked_pin_blocked.
